description: This file defines extension methods for the Kubernetes client, specifically to add a WatchAsync method that enables asynchronous watching of Kubernetes resources with cancellation support. It utilizes channels to manage streaming of watch events and handles proper disposal of resources.

classes.name: KubernetesClientExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for Kubernetes clients, notably the WatchAsync method for monitoring resource changes.

methods.name: WatchAsync
methods.description: An asynchronous extension method that returns an async enumerable of Kubernetes watch events, supporting cancellation and resource cleanup.
